headline_marked: 73 goals in 65 games: [[Harry Kane wins Ballon d'Or]] in London
headline: 73 goals in 65 games: Harry Kane wins Ballon d'Or in London
summary: The Bayern Munich forward becomes England's first Ballon d'Or winner in 25 years, beating out Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe.
details: Harry Kane has been crowned the 2026 Ballon d'Or winner in a historic ceremony held in London. The 33-year-old Bayern Munich forward beat out stiff competition from Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe to claim the award.
Kane's victory comes after a remarkable season where he scored 73 goals in 65 games for club and country, leading Bayern Munich to a league and cup double.
The England captain also contributed six goals during England's third-place finish at the World Cup, cementing his consistency as one of the world's best strikers.
In his acceptance speech, Kane credited his Bayern Munich teammates for pushing him to a higher level, stating that the achievement would not have been possible without them.
Alexia Putellas also claimed the women's Ballon d'Or for a third time, extending Spain's dominance in the women's game after leading Barcelona to a Champions League title.
Other winners included Luis de la Fuente as men's coach of the year for leading Spain to World Cup glory, and Bukayo Saka, who won the Socrates award for his humanitarian work.
Lamine Yamal, the 19-year-old Barcelona winger, won the young talent of the year award for the third consecutive time, though he fell short of the main prize.
The ceremony, the first ever to be held on English soil, faced an initial delay of nearly an hour due to heavy London traffic.
caption:
73 goals in 65 games. Harry Kane finally reaches the pinnacle of individual football glory.

Harry Kane has been crowned the 2026 Ballon d'Or winner in a historic ceremony held in London. The 33-year-old Bayern Munich forward beat out stiff competition from Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe to claim the award.

Kane's victory comes after a remarkable season where he scored 73 goals in 65 games for club and country, leading Bayern Munich to a league and cup double.

The England captain also contributed six goals during England's third-place finish at the World Cup, cementing his consistency as one of the world's best strikers.

In his acceptance speech, Kane credited his Bayern Munich teammates for pushing him to a higher level, stating that the achievement would not have been possible without them.

Alexia Putellas also claimed the women's Ballon d'Or for a third time, extending Spain's dominance in the women's game after leading Barcelona to a Champions League title.

Other winners included Luis de la Fuente as men's coach of the year for leading Spain to World Cup glory, and Bukayo Saka, who won the Socrates award for his humanitarian work.

Lamine Yamal, the 19-year-old Barcelona winger, won the young talent of the year award for the third consecutive time, though he fell short of the main prize.

The ceremony, the first ever to be held on English soil, faced an initial delay of nearly an hour due to heavy London traffic.

headline_marked: PM Tarique Rahman and Japan's Sanae Takaichi [[begin bilateral summit in Tokyo]]
headline: PM Tarique Rahman and Japan's Sanae Takaichi begin bilateral summit in Tokyo
summary: The two leaders aim to strengthen strategic partnerships, boost trade, and expand cooperation in renewable energy, agriculture, and digital transformation.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi began a bilateral summit in Tokyo today to strengthen strategic partnerships and boost trade and investment.
Tarique Rahman was accorded a guard of honour by the Japanese armed forces upon his arrival at the Kantei, the Japanese Prime Minister's Office.
The discussions focus on expanding cooperation in key sectors including renewable energy, agriculture, science and technology, digital transformation, and human resource development.
The Prime Minister is leading a high-level delegation including the Finance and Planning Minister, State Ministers for Foreign Affairs and Power, and the Governor of Bangladesh Bank.
This marks Tarique Rahman's third state visit abroad since taking office on February 17, following previous visits to Malaysia and China.
The summit includes bilateral talks, a joint announcement on the outcome of the discussions, and a luncheon hosted by Prime Minister Takaichi.
caption:
Strengthening ties for shared prosperity. PM Tarique Rahman and Japan's Sanae Takaichi meet in Tokyo for a high-level summit.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi began a bilateral summit in Tokyo today to strengthen strategic partnerships and boost trade and investment.

Tarique Rahman was accorded a guard of honour by the Japanese armed forces upon his arrival at the Kantei, the Japanese Prime Minister's Office.

The discussions focus on expanding cooperation in key sectors including renewable energy, agriculture, science and technology, digital transformation, and human resource development.

The Prime Minister is leading a high-level delegation including the Finance and Planning Minister, State Ministers for Foreign Affairs and Power, and the Governor of Bangladesh Bank.

This marks Tarique Rahman's third state visit abroad since taking office on February 17, following previous visits to Malaysia and China.

The summit includes bilateral talks, a joint announcement on the outcome of the discussions, and a luncheon hosted by Prime Minister Takaichi.
